<b>Spine Cores</b> are [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
Spine Cores are only available during the <i>[[Flexile Spines]]</i> wish, given out by [[Seamstress]] in the eastern [[Far Fields]]. 25 cores must be gathered to complete the wish and obtain the [[Drifter's Cloak]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Seamstress 01.png!Location in Far Fields
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Seamstress 01.png!Seamstress in Far Fields
}}

== How to Acquire ==
Spine Cores are dropped by [[Hoker|Hokers]] in Far Fields after accepting the <i>Flexile Spines</i> wish. Hokers fire 3 to 6 spines out of their bodies when provoked, and [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] can obtain a core by striking a spine, which otherwise disappear after a few seconds. 

Hornet can carry up to 25 Spine Cores, after which they will no longer drop from broken spines.
